studies.title: The Kangnido map
studies.caption: Korean scholars combine Chinese maps of the Mongol era with their own and Japan's into one map of the world from Korea to Europe and Africa.
studies.prompt: Three-quarter worktable scene in Joseon Korea about1402CE: scholars brush a large world map with a broad central East Asia, pronounced Korean peninsula at right, Japan lower right, smaller western lands and Africa toward left. No modern nation outlines or printed labels; rolled paper and brushwork.
